parole.significato: A type of coconut confectionery originating from the coasts of Latin America.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish cocada or Brazilian Portuguese cocada. Word was first referenced in 1878 in Peru.

parole.significato: A form of music originating in Argentina, Uruguay, and Southern Brazil.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish milonga, in turn from Brazilian Portuguese milonga (“chant”). Theories connect the word to the nineteenth century slave trade between South America and Africa.
